primaryEndpoint: Per-donor RMSE of log1p measured treated pseudobulk CPM against log1p conditional treated mean CPM, on every qualified model feature; matched no-change and training-only mean-log-response baselines. Report eligibility and solver exclusions over all source genes.
secondaryEndpoints: Per-donor MAE on the same log1p CPM scale
Fraction of matched genes improved over no change
Latent point-mass and numerical underflow frequencies
threshold: Development improvement requires at least 5 percent pooled RMSE reduction versus each matched baseline; additionally report every donor with worse RMSE. No independent biological validation claim.
intervals: No coverage claim: latent plug-in posterior spread lacks parameter uncertainty and is not a calibrated treated-count interval.
outcomeReads: Only after each complete fold prediction has been hashed and independently numerically checked. All studies already reused development data.
exactBaseline: max(0, log1p(query control pseudobulk CPM) + arithmetic mean over training donors of log1p(treated pseudobulk CPM) - log1p(control pseudobulk CPM)); no-change equals log1p(query control pseudobulk CPM).
pooledRMSE: sqrt(sum squared errors across scored genes and folds / total scored gene-folds), compared on identical eligible indices for every model
